headline: Teenage Engineering’s unique music machines are 30 percent off
summary: Teenage Engineering devices, blending music and art, are on sale. Known as grooveboxes, they produce real-time music from a single unit. A wide range of their eye-catching products are 30% off.

headline: Warner Bros. is suing Amazon for poaching employees
summary: Warner Bros. Discovery is suing Amazon for allegedly poaching employees. The lawsuit claims Amazon engaged in a 'lawless employee shopping spree'. Former Senior VP Pia Barlow is cited among the illegally recruited staff.

headline: Is this e-reader case a gun?
summary: A 3D-printed, pistol-shaped case for an Xteink X4 e-reader has gone viral. Created by Luke The Maker, the bizarre design mimics a Glock 19. The e-reader sits atop the 'gun's' slide, raising safety concerns.

headline: What Surrounds Us will make you think a lot about circles
summary: 'What Surrounds Us' is a game centered entirely around circles. Players control a donut-shaped circle, interacting with other sentient circles. The game features a large, circular map for exploration and collaboration.

headline: Absolute Batman and Absolute Martian Manhunter Win Big at the 2026 Eisner Awards
summary: DC's Absolute Universe shined at the 2026 Eisner Awards. 'Absolute Batman' secured a major trophy. 'Absolute Martian Manhunter' also claimed a significant win.

headline: What's Up With Those Avengers: Doomsday Latverian Witches at Comic-Con?
summary: Avengers: Doomsday teased 'Latverian Witches' costumes at SDCC. This hint suggests potential new characters for the MCU epic. Fans speculate an Infinity Stone or Scarlet Witch connection.

headline: Spaceballs: The New One Creators Talk CGI Yogurt and John Candy Tribute
summary: Rick Moranis and Josh Gad shared 'Spaceballs: The New One' updates at SDCC. Mel Brooks' character Yogurt will be CGI in the new film. The movie will feature new Star Wars gags and honor John Candy.

headline: God of War Laufey Release Date Announced
summary: The highly anticipated 'God of War Laufey' has a release date. Fans can mark their calendars for February 16, 2027. The announcement was made at Comic Con 2026.

headline: Tourists tell BBC how their holiday turned into race to escape fires
summary: Tourists in France recount their harrowing escape from wildfires. What began as holidays quickly became urgent evacuation missions. Families shared their experiences with the BBC.

headline: Police declare 'major incident' over Cairngorms wildfire
summary: A 'major incident' has been declared due to the Cairngorms wildfire. The spreading blaze threatens the village of Nethy Bridge. Some residents have evacuated their homes as a precaution.

headline: Laura Kuenssberg goes behind the scenes with Andy Burnham in his first week as PM
summary: Laura Kuenssberg offers an exclusive look into Andy Burnham's first week as PM. The report provides behind-the-scenes access to his new role. Viewers can see the early days of his premiership.

headline: Sean McCann, Madeleine's brother, makes Commonwealths final
summary: Sean McCann, brother of Madeleine McCann, has reached a major final. He will compete in the 400m freestyle at the Commonwealth Games. This marks a significant athletic achievement for McCann.
